original_query: What are three components of System Design?

confirmed.answer_text: System Design includes work flow; System Design includes HRM practices; System Design includes support technology
confirmed.summary: The image displays a flowchart illustrating the development of high-performance work systems, with 'System Design' as a central component that includes three key elements: work flow, HRM practices, and support technology. These elements lead to an implementation process and ultimately to organizational and employee outcomes.
